Reveal-eligible: storage (T04-ROW-071, T04-ROW-072), SDS (T04-ROW-073, T04-ROW-074), spraying conditions (T04-ROW-076), notification (T04-ROW-077), reporting (T04-ROW-078).

**Superseded base state (v2).** ALL obligation headings visible in the base state: Perundangan dan Pelesenan, Keselamatan dan Kesihatan (HSE), Pengurusan Risiko. The Akta Racun Makhluk Perosak 1974 citation and the licensed-operator requirement are on the base state, not behind an interaction.

**Accessibility.** Legal content must be reachable without interaction and must not depend on colour or hover alone.

**Fallback.** If stepping is unavailable, every obligation still renders. That is the point of putting them in the base state.

**D-04 split, applied.**

|  | Rows |
|---|---|
| base-visible, may not be hidden | T04-ROW-065, T04-ROW-066, T04-ROW-067, T04-ROW-068, T04-ROW-069, T04-ROW-070, T04-ROW-075 |
| reveal-eligible | T04-ROW-071, T04-ROW-072, T04-ROW-073, T04-ROW-074, T04-ROW-076, T04-ROW-077, T04-ROW-078 |
